question: How can I create an account?
answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button at the top right of the page, enter your name, email and a password, then verify your email address to activate your account.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email and we will send you a link to reset your password.

question: How do I place an order?
answer: Browse our products, add the items you like to the cart, click 'Checkout', enter your shipping address and choose a payment method to confirm your order.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard), PayPal, bank transfer and cash on delivery in selected areas.

question: Is it safe to pay online on your website?
answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted with SSL and we never store your full card details on our servers.

question: How long does delivery take? When will my order arrive?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 working days. Express delivery takes 1-2 working days. International orders may take 7-14 working days.

question: How much are the shipping charges?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above $50. For smaller orders a flat shipping fee of $5 is applied.

question: Do you deliver internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to more than 50 countries. Shipping cost and delivery time depend on your country and are shown at checkout.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: After your order is shipped we email you a tracking number. Enter it in the 'Track Order' page or log in to your account and open 'My Orders'.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel your order from 'My Orders' before it is shipped. Once it has been shipped you can refuse delivery or return it after receiving it.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: Yes, as long as the order has not been shipped. Contact our support team immediately with your order number and the new address.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packaging.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the item and click 'Return'. Print the return label, pack the item and hand it to the courier.

question: How long does it take to get a refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 working days after we receive your returned item and are sent to your original payment method.

question: I received a damaged or wrong item. What should I do?
answer: We are sorry about that! Please contact support within 48 hours with your order number and a photo of the item and we will send a replacement or refund.

question: Do your products come with a warranty?
answer: Yes, electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Other products have a 6-month warranty against defects.

question: Do you offer discounts or coupon codes?
answer: Yes! Subscribe to our newsletter to get a 10% welcome coupon, and follow our social media pages for seasonal sales.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: Enter your coupon code in the 'Promo Code' box on the cart page and click 'Apply'. The discount will show in your order total.

question: Is my personal information safe?
answer: Yes. We follow strict privacy policies, use encryption and never sell or share your personal data with third parties.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can email us at support@example.com, call +1-800-123-4567 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or use the live chat on our website.

question: What are your customer support working hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and on Saturday from 10am to 2pm.

question: Can I update my profile information?
answer: Yes. Log in, go to 'My Account' > 'Profile' and edit your name, phone number, email or address, then click 'Save'.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to 'My Account' > 'Settings' > 'Delete Account' or email support@example.com and we will delete your account and data within 7 days.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our app is available for free on the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.

question: How do I subscribe or unsubscribe from the newsletter?
answer: Enter your email in the newsletter box at the bottom of the page to subscribe. Use the 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom of any newsletter email to stop receiving them.

question: A product is out of stock. Will it be available again?
answer: Click 'Notify Me' on the product page and we will email you as soon as the item is back in stock.
